goal: Implement draggable, resizable, focus-managed app windows.
summary: Phase 2 — Window Manager completed (retry after grader feedback). Implemented a fully interactive window manager: Window component with Liquid Glass title bar and traffic-light buttons; pointer-event drag/resize with viewport bounds checking and jsdom-safe pointer-capture guards; WindowManagerProvider reducer store supporting open/close/minimize/maximize/restore/focus/move/resize with incremental z-index ordering; WindowManager renderer wiring store state to Window. Added Playwright e2e suite verifying render, focus/z-index, drag, resize, maximize/restore, minimize/close in a real Chromium browser. Captured a sequence of screenshots showing focus, drag, resize, and maximize transitions. Full Vitest (26 tests) and Playwright (6 tests) suites pass; production build succeeds. Source diff archived at /tmp/phase2-window-diff.patch.
stepSummaries:
